thread:
sec-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: potential secrets exposure — GCS log archive contains base64 blob and KMS key path. please triage.
sara: Thanks, starting triage. can someone paste the raw log line?
kyle: snippet: `2026-02-14T09:12:05Z INFO backup: data=CiABAj...==, kms_key=projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/ck-prod, account=prod-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
jen: Looks like ciphertext references ck-prod. not raw key material, but the SA shown could decrypt. blast radius = that SA + any principals that can impersonate it.
matt: Immediate steps: 1) block SA decrypt permission, 2) enumerate recent decrypt calls, 3) inventory where SA is used, 4) rotate/re-wrap if needed, 5) rotate Vault entries using that key.
dino: I'll apply a temporary deny on that SA for KMS decrypt. can we do it org-wide?
sara: Doing a targeted IAM patch on the prod keyring IAM to remove roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter for that SA. opening an emergency PR and will tag infra.
kyle: Make it 20m timeboxed. Also enable KMS admin audit logging (per-request) while we investigate.
jen: Running log query: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="prod-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"' --freshness=48h`
jen: Found 3 decrypts in last 12h, all from Cloud Run job `partner-ingest`. timestamps: 2026-02-14T05:10Z, 2026-02-14T07:49Z, 2026-02-14T08:59Z.
matt: That implies partner-ingest used KMS to decrypt. inform partner ops and ask for retention deletion of backups.
dino: Contacting partner now. copying standard notification template in #partners.
vault-bot: Querying Vault transit keys for usage of `ck-prod`... found entries: secret/ingest/config (v4), secret/backups/s3-creds (v2), secret/importer/token (v1), legacy/archive/token (v1).
jen: Good. Those need rotation if they were wrapped under ck-prod. vault-bot, can you mark them for rotation and generate rotation tasks?
vault-bot: Rotation tasks created: ROT-712, ROT-713, ROT-714, ROT-715. Assigned to jen and sara.
sara: I'll start rotating `secret/ingest/config` and `secret/importer/token` now. will bump versions and push new env refs.
kyle: Infra will create a new cryptoKey version (v2) and rewrap ciphertext to it. prefer rewrap over destroy to avoid data loss. ETA 90m.
matt: Also patch Terraform modules to prevent auto-granting that SA in future. add guardrail in iam module.
dino: Applied deny binding and created PR to add an org-level policy preventing the SA from getting crypto roles. link: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/5121
jen: Partner ops confirms they uploaded logs to a third-party bucket and will delete the archive. they also rotated their ingestion token.
sara: Legal looped in, but no confirmed exfil at this time. still treat as P1 until containment validated.
jen: Rotation procedure: create new key version `ck-prod/versions/2`, run rewrap tool `gcloud kms cryptokeys rewrap --location=us --keyring=kr --key=ck-prod --destination-key-version=2 --ciphertext-file=...` test on a sample blob first.
kyle: I'll run the rewrap on a copy and validate decryption with a service account in a staging project.
matt: After rewrap, update Vault transit key alias to point to new key version and rotate secrets. coordinate a short deploy window to avoid cached ciphertext in long-lived processes.
sara: I've started rotation on the ingest secrets. two deployments updated and redeployed to pick new secret versions. smoke tests passing.
dino: IAM patch merged, emergency deny auto-expiration set to 30m. monitoring alert configured to watch for any re-grant.
vault-bot: `secret/ingest/config` rotated to v5. `secret/importer/token` rotated to v2. backups creds rotation pending with ROT-713.
jen: Post-rotation checks: no decrypt calls for old key in last 15m, vault versions bumped, Cloud Run job redeployed to new secret versions.
kyle: Rewrap completed on sample blobs; full rewrap in progress. ETA 45m for all artifacts.
sara: Partner confirms deletion of third-party bucket object and provided deletion receipt. storing in incident tracker.
matt: Next steps: update TF modules, add RBAC hardening tasks, add monitoring regex to detect ciphertext patterns (e.g., `^Ci[A-Za-z0-9+/]{8,}`) and kms_key references.
jen: Updating incident INC-2026-810 with timeline and actions: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-810
sara: Drafting postmortem and follow-ups. owners: RBAC hardening = kyle, TF guardrails = matt, partner contract clause = eng-legal.
dino: Keeping the deny binding active for 2 hours while we finish verification. will revert if we see adverse impact.
sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-810 status moved to "contained" at 2026-02-14T12:46Z. Thanks team.
